program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((row-spans
          (filter (lambda (span) span)
            (for/list ([r (range 0 h)])
              (let ((cs (for/list ([c (range 0 w)] #:when (= (at g r c) 2)) c)))
                (if (>= (length cs) 2) (list r (min-list cs) (max-list cs)) #f)))))
         (col-spans
          (filter (lambda (span) span)
            (for/list ([c (range 0 w)])
              (let ((rs (for/list ([r (range 0 h)] #:when (= (at g r c) 3)) r)))
                (if (>= (length rs) 2) (list c (min-list rs) (max-list rs)) #f))))))
    (foldl
      (lambda (row-span out)
        (foldl
          (lambda (col-span acc)
            (let ((r (first row-span)) (c0 (second row-span)) (c1 (third row-span))
                  (c (first col-span)) (r0 (second col-span)) (r1 (third col-span)))
              (if (and (<= c0 c) (<= c c1) (<= r0 r) (<= r r1))
                  (set-cell acc r c 8)
                  acc)))
          out
          col-spans))
      (empty-grid h w 0)
      row-spans)))
